cohort: The study recruited 350 pregnant women in different trimesters who attended antenatal checkups at a government health complex and a private hospital in rural Bangladesh.
finding: The point prevalence of antenatal depression was 39%, and gestational week, unintended pregnancy, intimate partner violence, a history of previous diseases, and having polygamous husbands were significantly associated with its development.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, specifically from January 08 to January 14, 2024.
